title: Project blocked Outcome gate and recovery facts
outOfScope: Changing Cockpit status-page projection, external-wait states, archive history, provider workflows, or release policy; those belong to their separately tracked Work Items.
Rewriting any existing archived Outcome merely to add the new fields.
Relaxing Outcome validation or archive eligibility for blocked, stale, or contradictory evidence.

riskAssessment.reason: Outcome truth controls whether reviewers can distinguish a blocked recovery path from archive-eligible completion; false green or omitted recovery evidence can authorize unsafe lifecycle progression.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: The issue, current generator/render/validator/Finish pipeline, and reproducible historical Outcomes establish the exact affected boundary.

reasons: P1 lifecycle truth and archive-authorization correction requires strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized automatic governed remediation and explicitly requires Outcome red/yellow/green diagnostics to be visible rather than inferred.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Freeze the JSON, rendering, validation, Finish integration, test, documentation, and generated-evidence surfaces before lifecycle verification.

acceptance: Every newly generated blocked Outcome carries top-level humanStatusColor=red, a non-empty failedGate, and a non-empty actionable recoveryCondition derived from verified Finish failure facts.
Newly generated completed and warning/incomplete Outcomes carry the canonical green or yellow humanStatusColor without allowing a later failure or blocked state to appear green.

The canonical Outcome Markdown visibly renders the traffic-light value and, for blocked Outcomes, the failed gate and recovery condition; JSON and Markdown validation rejects malformed new-version projection fields.
Historical archived Outcomes without the new fields remain readable and are never rewritten; only newly generated Outcome schema versions require the stronger projection fields.

Red-first unit and integration regressions cover early/post-verification blocked Outcomes, missing or contradictory fields, completed color, Markdown visibility, and archive-failure truth preservation.

Finish quality routing honors the Contract governanceProfile: automatic profiles are reclassified from the final declared scope without lowering a recorded higher level, while human overrides cannot lower strict verification.

Cockpit lifecycle documentation and generated capability evidence describe the canonical Outcome diagnostic fields without claiming that the separate status-page or external-wait Work Items are delivered.
guidelines: Keep one canonical Outcome fact model: generators produce facts, renderers display them, and validators reject contradictions; do not infer colors independently in consumers.
Derive blocked failedGate and recoveryCondition only from structured Finish failure facts, never from chat text or mutable archived evidence.
Preserve backward validation compatibility for historic archived Outcomes while requiring the new schema version for newly generated Outcomes.
Do not widen archive, status-page, provider, or release behavior beyond the declared Outcome projection boundary.

intent.problem: A blocked Finish currently records its failed gate and recovery direction in the Summary, but the canonical Outcome JSON and Markdown expose only a status string. Reviewers must cross-read artifacts and cannot verify the red diagnostic from the Outcome itself; completed colors are likewise not consistently visible in the rendered Outcome.
constraints: Do not edit immutable archived Outcome bytes or permit stale evidence to authorize archive.
Keep blocked, incomplete, and completed states fail-closed and machine-validated.
Preserve legacy archive readability while versioning stronger requirements for new generated Outcomes.
Do not implement the separate Cockpit status-page projection or external-execution state model in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: Making the diagnostic fields canonical at the Outcome source lets every later report and projection display the same evidence-backed red/yellow/green state, reduces operator ambiguity, and supplies the data boundary required by the separate visibility Work Item.

declaredIntent.summary: Make Outcome traffic-light, failed-gate, and recovery facts canonical and visibly rendered for newly generated lifecycle evidence.

rawUserRequest: 目标：执行计划，到全部完成。我授权给你自动执行，写入到每个工单的Contract里。Outcome报告必须输出，并以红绿灯明确显示；流程问题不采用临时修改，必须根除。

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An early or post-verification Finish gate fails.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The new blocked Outcome is red and exposes the exact failed gate and an actionable retry recovery condition in JSON and Markdown.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Red-first generator, validator, renderer, and Finish integration tests for missing, malformed, early, and post-verification diagnostic facts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Work Item reaches a valid completed Outcome or a warning/incomplete Outcome.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The canonical Outcome contains and renders green only for completed and yellow for warning/incomplete states.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Generator and renderer regressions for complete and cautionary colors plus validator contradiction cases.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A blocked or later-failed lifecycle attempts to generate or archive Outcome evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No Outcome with a red/blocked fact can be represented as green; historic archive bytes remain unchanged and invalid new canonical fields fail validation.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Integration regressions for blocked failures, archive/reuse truth, and legacy Outcome validation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized automatic execution of all remediation Work Items and specifically required canonical visible Outcome red/yellow/green diagnostics; the restricted .ai Cockpit documentation and governance runtime paths are declared before before_edit.

rollbackNote: Revert generator, renderer, validator, Finish integration, documentation, generated evidence, and tests together; do not edit historical archives as rollback.
